'''Rotha Tol'min''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hoping to establish himself as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] sometime between [[130 ABY]] and [[137 ABY]]. [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Deliah Blue]], and [[Jariah Syn]] were contracted to take him out.<ref name="A Broken Plan" />
